blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Monad 0x1111b3ded9f1fe1801ad4ebef8e2788183a24111 holds 100% of EURW supply. At Monad block 114682014 (2026-10-19T06:19:14Z) the proxy still resolves to implementation 0x52778511bec5ff87f9b52c7a2434631edcc157f4 and paused() is false. Hacken's March 12, 2026 audit and the implementation expose a BLACKLISTER_ROLE-gated blacklist that blocks ordinary transfers and approvals, plus a PAUSER_ROLE. The genesis-to-pin role census has no BLACKLISTER_ROLE or PAUSER_ROLE grant; ADMIN_ROLE is held by EOA 0x1c4f1a908ae8c15c3fef774775b8e897c1fc9ca6, which can grant either immediately. The blacklist is therefore a mutable, issuer-controlled holder-facing surface that is not currently armed: direct Possible, not an active direct blacklist. The redemption policy separately permits wallet blocking and lawful-order freezing. Hedera key observations are excluded because no issuer exact-token binding was retrieved.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Only the exact CoinGecko-bound Monad issuer-native EURW deployment is authored. The whitepaper also describes Hedera, but token lead 0.0.10250174 lacks an issuer exact-ID binding and is excluded. No cross-chain bridge mechanism or controller is established by a network-support statement.
